verdict.rationale: The enterprise-readiness docs list data-residency options including regional endpoints, single-tenant, and BYOC. Self-hosting on Kubernetes via Helm on AWS, Azure, or GCP keeps data inside the customer's own infrastructure, so storage location is under their control. Missing for 10: details on which regions the managed SaaS offers and how to select them, whether regional endpoints are self-serve or enterprise-only, and independent or hands-on confirmation of residency guarantees.
